Before you call

Straight answers to common questions.

When are emergency hours?＋

Normal operating hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm. Times and days outside that schedule are emergency hours. Call to describe the issue; technician response depends on availability and location.

Do you offer free estimates?＋

Free estimates are available for HVAC installations. Diagnostic or repair pricing is confirmed separately based on the service request.

Is financing available?＋

Financing options are available. Ask for the current provider, eligibility details, rates, and terms that apply to your project.

Do you work with commercial properties?＋

Yes. Current services include commercial HVAC maintenance and refrigeration inquiries. Call with the facility and equipment details so the team can confirm fit.

How do I know if you cover my address?＋

The business is based in Dawsonville and serves surrounding communities. Share the service address and the type of work needed to confirm availability before scheduling.
